diff --git a/internal/config/tracing_test.go b/internal/config/tracing_test.go

index 0000000..f130378
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/config/tracing_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingDefaultsAndOverrides(t *testing.T) {
+	defaults := Default().Tracing
+	require.Equal(t, float64(1), defaults.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, defaults.Propagators)
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n"), 0600))
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.5, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestTracingValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN(), math.Inf(1)} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}
+		require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+
+	cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: 1, Propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorBaggage, "unknown"}}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestLoadRejectsInvalidTracing(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		body string
+		want string
+	}{
+		{"ratio below zero", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: -0.1\n", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"ratio above one", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 1.1\n", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"unknown propagator", "tracing:\n  propagators: [tracecontext, unknown]\n", "invalid propagator option: unknown"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tc.body), 0600))
+			_, err := Load(path)
+			require.EqualError(t, err, tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"math"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingDefaultsAndOverrides(t *testing.T) {
+	defaults := Default().Tracing
+	require.Equal(t, float64(1), defaults.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, defaults.Propagators)
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n"), 0600))
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.5, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestTracingValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1, math.NaN(), math.Inf(1)} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}
+		require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: ratio}
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+
+	cfg := TracingConfig{SamplingRatio: 1, Propagators: []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorBaggage, "unknown"}}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+}
+
+func TestLoadRejectsInvalidTracing(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		body string
+		want string
+	}{
+		{"ratio below zero", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: -0.1\n", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"ratio above one", "tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 1.1\n", "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1"},
+		{"unknown propagator", "tracing:\n  propagators: [tracecontext, unknown]\n", "invalid propagator option: unknown"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tc.body), 0600))
+			_, err := Load(path)
+			require.EqualError(t, err, tc.want)
+		})
+	}
+}
